items.title: Seeking legal advise on SEBI order in land pledge case, no bearing on ongoing fundraising: ZEEL
items.description: ZEEL may challenge the Sebi order before the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT), a quasi-judicial body, which has appellate jurisdiction to hear appeals against Sebi orders.

items.title: 'Do what India needs': Noel Tata charts Tata Trusts' new roadmap focused on healthcare, education
items.description: Noel Tata said the Trusts would continue to be guided by a philosophy that has shaped the Tata Group for more than a century.

items.title: AI boom, West Asia crisis trigger printed circuit board shortage, price rise in electronics industry
items.description: The shortage of PCBs comes at a critical juncture for Indian industry as several major investments amounting to over Rs 15,000 crore are in the pipeline under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) amid rising domestic demand.

items.title: British brewer Lion returns to India after 60 years, enters Delhi market with premium beer
items.description: The company has partnered with Copperdrop Spirits as its exclusive importer and distributor in India, with plans to expand distribution to Haryana and Uttar Pradesh in the next phase

items.title: Drill, Baby, Drill: Why India is paying up to Rs 650 crore per deepsea well to cut oil imports
items.description: Officials acknowledged that deepwater exploration is a long-term investment and that not every well will result in commercially viable discoveries

items.title: The onus lies with IndiGo and Air India: Rahul Bhatia on bringing aviation wealth back to India
items.description: Rahul Bhatia said IndiGo's long-haul strategy would primarily focus on serving Indian travellers and the global Indian diaspora.

items.title: Gokul Agro Resources Q1 profit up 74% at Rs 123 crore
items.description: Revenue from operations of the company grew by 7 per cent during the quarter under review at Rs 5,281.95 crores as compared to Rs 4,924.35 crores in the same period of the previous fiscal year

items.title: RRP Electronics, Orvis Semi to jointly develop sensors for defence applications
items.description: Under the leadership of Prof. Mukul Sarkar of IIT Delhi, Orvis Semi has been developing advanced CMOS-based Low Light Imaging Sensors capable of digitising images while functioning as intelligent surveillance devices, the statement said.
